text.String: Model Core | Poly modeling, kitbashing, and scene assembly.
Sculpt Forge | Brush-heavy form work, voxel remesh, and high frequency detail.
Surface Graph | Material layering, shader previews, and lookdev iteration.
UV And Paint | UV layout, texture projection, and paint layer review.
Rig And Pose | Rig controls, deformation checks, and pose-space sculpt review.
Review And Publish | Topology review, export summaries, and materialization receipts.
Bootstrap Project | project.bootstrap | Seeds the canonical project, scene, preview, and publish session state.
Switch Workspace | workspace.switch_mode | Moves the operator into a different workspace mode and marks downstream inspectors for refresh.
Activate Tool | tool.activate | Changes the active authoring tool and updates the live tool preset context.
Set Selection | selection.set | Replaces the live entity selection and updates inspector read models.
Frame Selection | viewport.frame_selection | Repositions the active camera around the current selection without mutating resources.
Apply Brush | mesh.brush_apply | Applies a sculpt stroke, invalidates preview/topology state, and schedules the brush intent lane.
Rebake Preview | preview.rebake | Refreshes the GPU preview resources for the current session state.
Refresh Topology | analysis.topology_refresh | Runs the topology report intent against the current mesh resources.
Refresh Publish Summary | publish.summary_refresh | Recomputes the publish summary artifact from the latest reports and resources.

Viewport Stage | viewport3d | Primary model editing viewport backed by the native runtime lane.
Scene Outliner | tree | Hierarchy navigation for scene objects, kits, and fabrication groups.
Asset Browser | tree | Mesh, material, shader, brush, and package browsing.
Selection Inspector | inspector | Transforms, topology, metadata, and material assignment.
Tool Shelf | inspector | Model, sculpt, retopo, UV, paint, and review tools.
Material Graph | graph | Surface graph authoring and shader routing.
Procedural Stack | graph | Procedural modifiers, instancing, and generation layers.
Topology Console | graph | Topology metrics, retopo hints, and mesh health reporting.
Fabric Timeline | timeline | Fabric step execution and report flow.
Publish Summary | inspector | Export readiness, delivery notes, and bundle summary.
Select | Selection, hierarchy filtering, and transform handoff.
Extrude | Poly modeling and shell generation.
Boolean | Destructive and non-destructive mesh cutting.
Clay Sculpt | Brush-based form building with native preview stamping.
Voxel Remesh | Topology reset and sculpt mesh cleanup.
UV Pack | Chart packing and texel density review.
Material Paint | Mask, ID, and layer authoring.
Publish Bundle | Fabric summary, bundle materialization, and export review.
Project Bootstrap | fabric/intents/project_bootstrap.fabric.toml | produces 4 targets
Brush Apply | fabric/intents/brush_apply.fabric.toml | produces 1 targets
Preview Rebake | fabric/intents/preview_rebake.fabric.toml | produces 2 targets
Topology Refresh | fabric/intents/topology_refresh.fabric.toml | produces 0 targets
Publish Summary Refresh | fabric/intents/publish_summary.fabric.toml | produces 1 targets
mesh://scene/main/entity/cube_01 | shared_buffer | Primary scene mesh stream authored by the Kain seed step.
buffer://preview/source | shared_buffer | Source preview buffer passed into the GPU compute preview lane.
buffer://preview/destination | shared_buffer | Destination preview buffer populated by the GPU preview bake.
image://preview/baked | shared_image | Baked preview image projected into the viewport and publish inspectors.
buffer://brush/latest_stamp | shared_buffer | Latest brush stamp buffer emitted by the native helper.
python_project_seed | python | Seeds project defaults, viewport sizing, brush accent, and mesh counts.
model_seed | kain | Authors the scene seed, mesh stream, preview image, and scene report.
native_brush | c_abi | Uses the native helper to stamp the preview and emit a brush snapshot.
topology_analyzer | rust_crate | Computes topology-facing checksums and health reporting.
gpu_preview | gpu_compute | Runs the preview stream through the Fabric GPU path.
node_publisher | kain | Builds the operator-facing publish/export summary through the Kain-to-Node bridge.
Canonical session document lives in session/session_schema.kn
Reducers mark dirty state before heavy work executes
Intent planner maps commands into reusable Fabric graphs
Resource and report stores project back into the native runtime snapshot
